title: DR1 ends the review page with a Continue button on its own; the frontend adds a "Now submit your notification" heading and a sentence telling the user what the button does.

controls.text: Continue to the declaration to submit your notification.

finding.frontend: Below the last summary card the frontend renders a second-level heading, "Now submit your notification", and a paragraph, "Continue to the declaration to submit your notification.", before the Continue button — src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/template.njk:108-109, with the wording in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:109-113. The heading is numbered nowhere and sits at the same level as the numbered section headings above it, so it reads as an extra unnumbered section on a page whose sections are otherwise counted.
finding.prototype: DR1 puts nothing between the last card and the button: the form holds a Continue button and no heading or explanatory text — app/views/review-notification.html:181-187. The button is the whole call to action, and what follows it is the declaration page, which explains itself.
finding.difference: Delete the heading and the paragraph, leaving the Continue button directly under the last card, and remove the two now-unused copy keys from both the English and Welsh files. Do it with the read-only change to the same block so the foot of the page is touched once.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend review page rendering a Continue button with no heading or paragraph above it.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs and both screenshots; ran the falsifier — fe-check-answers.html:567-575 and fe-check-answers-submitted.html:494-502 both render the h2, the paragraph and then the button, so it does not fire. Checked template.njk:108-114 and copy.en.js:109-113, both of which land exactly on the cited content, and confirmed DR1 puts nothing between the last card and the form at review-notification.html:179-187. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: both change the same block at the foot of the page
